files.name: motion-prompt-099.txt
PROMPT.md
files.content:
Please use "Silhouette" (シルエット), one of the names in "Photo looks, lighting & styles".
Motion Prompt #099

What it is: The subject shows as a black shape against a bright sky
What the sample shows: As the exposure is set for the bright evening sky, the person, buildings, lamp and tree turn into flat black shapes with no detail and only the sky stays bright.
Spec:
- Scene 1: a head-and-shoulders figure in front of a horizon at y 150 (head centre x 270, y 78, radius 29 px, no face or hair). 
- Sky: #FAF9F7 → #FFEDC4 at the top and a #FFCF73 band near the horizon (y 92–150)
- Everything but the sky becomes #2A2D36, the far hills #4A4546; the figure #22252D
- Sun: radius 20 px at x 404, sinking from y 60 to y 128, half hidden by the hills
- Top-right readout: ±0.0 EV → −2.0 EV
- Timing: the effect comes in from 0.4 s to 1.4 s, holds until 4.0 s and is gone again by 4.8 s (one pass = 5 s, cubic ease-in-out (about cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)))
When to use it: When the shape and pose should carry the picture, against a sunset or a bright window.

Reference implementation (Canvas 2D, a function whose picture depends only on the time): https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/en/e/099.txt
Shared helper code: https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/kit/photo.js
Keep the shapes, timing and easing values of the reference implementation as they are, and change only the text, colours and assets to fit what I am making.
